title: CORE-6965 · SITEWIDE image resolution — VERIFIED, not a code defect
body:
**Linear:** [CORE-6965](https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-6965)

**Premise wrong. No code fix exists — no PR opened.**

223 raster images across 11 pages measured at `deviceScaleFactor: 2`, live vs a local production build.
Metric: effective DPR = `naturalWidth / rendered CSS width`.

## The decisive number

**0 of 86 under-resolution images were next/image under-requesting.** Every one was already served at its
full master width. There is no component/`sizes` bucket anywhere on the site.

## "SITEWIDE" is not accurate

137/223 images are already >=1.9x. Of the 86 below, **62 are byte-for-byte identically soft on live**
(same file, same box). Live is not a uniformly-2x site either — 49 of its 203 images are under 1.5x.

**Only 17 instances / 9 unique assets are genuine regressions**, and all are CMS media, not code:
- **8 bank logos** — clone master 64x64, live **116x116** (the clone imported the wrong variant at seed)
- **`john-warbuton.webp`** — clone **400x400**, live **800x800**

## Corrections to prior notes

- The CORE-6993 follow-up recorded `john-warbuton.webp` as 300x300. It is **400x400** — already partially
  bumped — but live is 800x800, so still half-res. It belongs under this ticket.
- The `no-vw sizes` mechanism inherited from CORE-7133 is **refuted as a resolution cause**: next/image
  clamps candidates to master width and never upscales, and a `w`-descriptor srcset's fallback `src` is
  the *largest* candidate. Measured: `sizes="200px"` (the exact trap) resolves to `&w=640` and returns
  the full 200x50 master. It makes the browser request **more**, never less — a byte-waste defect that
  belongs to CORE-7133 and would not change one delivered pixel.

## Also ruled out

Compression: clone serves AVIF where live serves WebP/JPEG at a mean byte ratio ~1.0. Clone pages are
already 1.5-4x lighter than live, because live ships unresized originals (one at DPR 9.7 — a 3251x2486
photo in a 338x300 box). Rows where live looks "sharper" are live waste, not clone defects.

## Flagged, deliberately not fixed

The site's genuinely worst images are 23 FAQ topic cards at **DPR 0.49-0.84** (280x165 masters in a 573px
box) — but **live serves the identical files**. Fixing them would make the clone exceed live, so this is
an upstream content issue, not a clone-fidelity defect.

## Recommended disposition

Close as not-a-code-defect and re-scope to a **CMS media task** for the 9 assets (live source URLs to
re-harvest are in the agent's FINDINGS.md).
acceptanceCriteria: Ticket closed or re-scoped off SITEWIDE — it is not a code defect.
CMS media task raised for the 9 assets (8 bank logos 64->116, john-warbuton 400->800).
no-vw sizes byte-waste folded into CORE-7133 as a payload fix, not a resolution one.
FAQ topic-card softness recorded as an upstream content issue, not a clone defect.
